title: Implement automatic database seeding with default job roles on deployment

requirements.text: Add initialization logic to the backend main actor that automatically seeds the database with default job roles (Data Analyst, Web Developer, AI Engineer, DevOps Engineer, UI/UX Designer) when the canister is first deployed or when no job roles exist in the system

quotes: No job roles available. Please contact an administrator. not working
Should the application automatically seed the database with predefined job roles (like Data Analyst, Web Developer, AI Engineer, etc.) when it first deploys, so users always have options available?

acceptanceCriteria: Backend automatically creates default job roles on first deployment
Seeding occurs when no job roles exist in the system
Each default job role includes a comprehensive set of required skills with appropriate proficiency levels (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced) and categories (Technical/Soft Skills)
Seeding logic runs without requiring manual admin intervention
Existing job roles are not affected or duplicated during subsequent deployments

requirements.text: Define default job roles with realistic skill requirements including Data Analyst (SQL, Python, Excel, Statistics, Data Visualization, Power BI/Tableau), Web Developer (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Git, REST APIs), AI Engineer (Python, Machine Learning, TensorFlow/PyTorch, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision), DevOps Engineer (Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS/Azure/GCP, Git, Bash scripting), and UI/UX Designer (Figma/Adobe XD, User Research, Wireframing, Prototyping, Visual Design, HTML/CSS basics)
acceptanceCriteria: Each job role has 6-10 required skills covering both technical and soft skills
Skills include appropriate proficiency levels matching industry expectations
Skills are categorized correctly as Technical or Soft Skills
Default data reflects current industry standards for each role

requirements.text: Update the JobRoleSelector component to show a loading state while job roles are being fetched or seeded, displaying a spinner or skeleton loader instead of the 'No job roles available. Please contact an administrator.' error message when roles are still being initialized
acceptanceCriteria: Loading state displays while job roles query is in progress
User sees a spinner or skeleton loader during initialization
Error message 'No job roles available. Please contact an administrator.' only appears for genuine errors, not during loading
Smooth transition from loading state to populated job role list

constraints: Maintain single-actor architecture with all logic in backend/main.mo
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui/*
Preserve existing admin CRUD functionality for job roles
Seeding must not interfere with manually created job roles
nonGoals: Modifying the admin interface for job role management
Changing the skill matching algorithm or cosine similarity calculation
Altering the resume upload or parsing functionality
Adding new job roles beyond the five specified defaults
Implementing database migration logic for existing deployments with data
